faqDesktop.q: How does the purchase process work?
faqDesktop.a: Purchases are completed through Atom.com's escrow service, which handles both payment and domain transfer. For multi-domain acquisitions or custom arrangements, transactions can be facilitated through Escrow.com.
Each domain is presented with custom logo concepts, which are available to buyers on request.
Payment plans are available for select domains and are facilitated through Atom.com. Contact Midjump with the domain of interest and your preferred payment timeline.
